description: A formula represents a truth function on a fixed finite input list when it uses only listed atoms and gives the prescribed value at every valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Represents.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → α)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.TruthFunction n)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) : Prop
